resources.string: The curated 3D globe with your media, cluster sections and the detailed map land here in milestone M4.
Timeline card and device folders with the automatic upload switch arrive in milestone M3.
Device files merged with the cloud index, badges, filters, selection, viewer and actions arrive in milestone M2.
Manual and smart albums with the rule builder, covers and upload retries arrive in milestone M3.
Server discovery, account and security, theme, language and updates arrive with milestone M1 and later.
Manual uploads, per-folder backup, verification, the background job and the kDrive connection arrive in milestone M5.
